exam_name: Group 1 Sub Group 2 Combined Recruitment Test 2025

Medical Social Worker: Bachelor's degree in Sociology, Medical Social Work, or M.S.W. from a recognized university
Assistant Statistical Officer: Second-class graduate degree in Statistics, Mathematics, or Economics
Physiotherapist: Bachelor's degree in Physiotherapy; registration with the MP Paramedical Council
Clinical Psychologist: Master's degree in Psychology with one year of hospital experience
Assistant Hospital Administrator: Master's degree in Hospital Administration/Management with one year of relevant experience
Biochemist: M.M.L.T. (Biochemistry) or MLT/Biochemistry with D.M.L.T. or Diploma in Clinical Biochemistry; Medical Council registration required
Sub-Registrar: Master's degree in Hospital Administration/Management with one year of hospital administration experience
Hospital Assistant/Manager: Master's degree in Hospital Administration, Management, or MBA (HR) with three years of relevant academic/managerial experience
